Masrūq

English
Transmission wording
805: 1:11. Sufyan, from al-Amash, from Abu al-Duha, from Masruq, who said:
Abd Allah recited it "al-kawakib" (verse 6).

04

“there is no ghawl in it”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 37:47).

808
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 808: 4: 12

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
808: 4:12. Sufyan said: Mujahid said,
"there is no ghawl in it": He said, their stomachs will not ache ⦗p. 253⦘ "nor will they be intoxicated by it": their minds will not be drained; some of them said, headache (verse 47). "Then behold, from the graves they will rush to their Lord": He said, the grave (verse 51 of Ya Sin).
العربية
الإسناد

English

08

“The yaqtin is the gourd [qar]”

An explanation transmitted from Habib ibn Abi Thabit (Q 37:146, 37:147).

814
Explanation from Habib ibn Abi Thabit No. 814: 10: 4

Habib ibn Abi Thabit

English
Transmission wording
814: 10:4. Sufyan, from Habib ibn Abi Thabit, who said:
Ibn Abbas was told, "The yaqtin is the gourd [qar]." He said, "Why is the gourd more deserving than the watermelon?" (verse 146). 815: [number unclear] 10. Sufyan, from Mansur, from al-Hakim ibn Abd Allah al-Azwar al-Nasri, from a freedman of Ibn Abbas, from Ibn Abbas, on His words "to a hundred thousand or more": ⦗p. 255⦘ He said, they were a hundred thousand. Some of them said, rather they were more (verse 147).
العربية
814: 10: 4 سفيان عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ قَالَ قِيلَ لِابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ إِنَّ الْيَقْطِينَ الْقَرْعُ قَالَ مَا بَالُ القرع أحق من البطيخ (الآية 146) . 11 10 سفيان عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنِ الْحَاكِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَزْوَرِ النَّصْرِيِّ عَنْ مولى لابن عباس عن بن عباس في قوله إِلَى مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ ⦗p. 255⦘ يزيدون قَالَ كَانُوا مِائَةَ أَلْفٍ قَالَ بعضهم بل كانوا يزيدون (الآية 147) .

09

“they made between Him and the jinn a kinship”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 37:158).

816
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 816: 12: 7

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
816: 12:7. Sufyan, from Rabah, from Qays ibn Sad, from Mujahid, on His words
"they made between Him and the jinn a kinship": He said, the daughters of the chiefs of the jinn. He said, they are "daughters," meaning of God, Mighty and Majestic. So God, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: "The jinn have known that they will be brought forth": He said, brought forth to punishment (verse 158).
العربية
816: 12: 7 سفيان عَنْ رَبَاحٍ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ بينه وبين الجنة نسبا قَالَ بَنَاتُ سَرَاةِ الْجِنِّ قَالَ هُمْ بَنَاتٌ يَعْنُونَ اللَّهَ عز وجل فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عز وجل علمت الجنة إنهم لمحضرون قال محضرون العذاب (الآية 158) .
Edition record 371494 · p. 255Link to report ↗
10

“If only we had something [a scripture] to hasten to”

An explanation transmitted from al-Ḥasan (Q 37:168).

817
Explanation from al-Ḥasan No. 817: 13: 6

al-Ḥasan

English
Transmission wording
817: 13:6. Sufyan, from Abu Mawdud, from al-Hasan, who said:
The Muslims said, "If only we had something [a scripture] to hasten to." So there was revealed about it: "If we had a reminder from the earlier peoples" (verse 168).
العربية
817: 13: 6 سفيان عَنْ أَبِي مَوْدُودٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ قَالَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ لَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا أَمْرًا نَبْتَدِرُهُ قَالَ فَنَزَلَ عنه أَنَّ عِنْدَنَا ذِكْرًا مِنَ الأَوَّلِينَ (الآية 168) .
